name: doorward
description: Doorward — user, group, and permission management with REST and gRPC

scripts.compose:up: DOORWARD_DATABASE_KIND=postgres DOORWARD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://doorward:doorward@postgres:5432/doorward docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile postgres up --build
scripts.compose:up:mssql: DOORWARD_DATABASE_KIND=mssql DOORWARD_DATABASE_URL=mssql://doorward:doorward@mssql:1433/doorward docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile mssql up --build
scripts.compose:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile postgres --profile mssql down --remove-orphans
